name: Midwest FurFest
blurb: One of the largest furry conventions in the world, held every December at the Donald E. Stephens Convention Center in Rosemont.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'From December 3-6, join us in Rosemont, Illinois, for FurFest 2026: Bark to the Future!' and footer 'DECEMBER 3 - 6, 2026 - ROSEMONT, IL.' Venue confirmed on the registration page: 'Hall F of the Donald E. Stephens Convention Center in Rosemont, IL.'

notes: The three 2026 Guests of Honor (Betamonkey, Snuffles, Zesty) each have a full bio paragraph and photo on the Guests of Honor page; known-for is condensed from that bio text rather than the con's single-word GoH labels.
